synopsis: The booklet identifies SERNAGEOMIN as Chile’s mining regulator but does not verify its guidance, a limitation recorded in both the rules chapter and glossary [f2293, f15583]. The rules chapter also leaves Codelco standards unverified, while the glossary reports that no dedicated Chilean braking test standard was found [f2293, f15583]. Separately, the accident review found no Chilean machine-collision breakdowns by movement type associated with SERNAGEOMIN, alongside similar gaps in several other jurisdictions [f3170]. These findings leave gaps in both regulatory verification and accident evidence; they do not establish that guidance, standards, or collision breakdowns do not exist [f2293, f3170, f15583].

relations.note: Both state that SERNAGEOMIN guidance was not verified.
